name: 29420 · N Charleston, SC
findings: ZIP 29420 (N Charleston) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29420 (N Charleston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29420 (N Charleston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
